bioconda.name: bamslice
bioconda.summary: Extract byte ranges from BAM files and convert to interleaved FASTQ format for parallel processing
bioconda.description:
bamslice extracts specific byte ranges from BAM files and converts them to
interleaved FASTQ format. Designed for parallel processing across compute nodes
without requiring pre-indexing. It auto-aligns to BGZF block boundaries and
guarantees no duplicate reads when using contiguous byte ranges.

biotools.summary: Extract reads from byte ranges of an unaligned BAM file and convert to interleaved FASTQ format for parallel processing. Only decompresses the relevant range.

function.note: slice all the records from example.bam  that start within the specfied byte range (only decompressing the relevant blocks)
